prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web dashboard hero redesign decision comp for eBuhay
Primary request: Create Option C, "Civic Record Fold", for an established Philippine donation and transplant demo. Show one 1536x1024 design board containing three realistic full-width dashboard opening sections stacked vertically: Recipient, Donor, and Hospital Administrator. Each strip must read as an actual responsive web application viewport crop, not a poster.
Structure: Every strip has a quiet white or cloud canvas and a 1200px content container. Build one compact bordered hero surface with a narrow colored vertical role rail on the far left, a dominant text region in the middle, and a pale structured summary ledger on the right. The colored rail contains only a simple line icon and the role name. The middle carries headline and concise support text. The right ledger has one prominent current status or pending count above a single-line row of three facts. No calls to action. Hint at the unchanged thin network band and pill tab navigation below each hero so the page mode is unmistakable.
Recipient content: role "RECIPIENT"; headline "Your care journey, clearly in view."; supporting copy "Track your match status and the details guiding your next step."; status "Clinical review in progress"; facts "Blood O+", "Kidney", "High urgency".
Donor content: role "DONOR"; headline "Your pledge is ready when it matters."; supporting copy "Keep your donation details current while eBuhay looks for a compatible recipient."; status "Registry active"; facts "Blood O-", "2 organs pledged", "Available".
Hospital content: role "HOSPITAL ADMIN"; headline "Philippine General Hospital"; supporting line "Match triage and institutional review"; identifier "PGH-MNL-1000"; location "Taft Avenue, Manila"; dominant metric "8 Pending review"; secondary facts "3 Approved", "1 Active procedure", "2 Today".
Style/medium: polished high-fidelity web UI mockup, semantic HTML/CSS appearance, crisp text, no photography.
Color palette: eBuhay Blue #0038A8 for recipient, Recovery Green #059669 for donor, Lifeline Red #CE1126 for hospital urgency, navy #06145B for text, white #FFFFFF, cloud #F8FAFC, ink #0F172A, slate #64748B. Hope Gold #F59E0B only for high urgency.
Typography: Figtree-like bold friendly civic headings; Noto Sans-like body; disciplined compact hierarchy.
Materials: one cohesive white working surface per hero, 1px pale slate border, 12-16px corners, restrained ambient shadow; right ledger uses pale cloud, never a separate floating card grid.
Focal moment: the colored vertical role rail joining identity, headline, and status into one civic record.
Constraints: This is visibly an eBuhay demo/prototype dashboard, not an official government portal. Preserve role distinction. No behavior changes, no buttons, no illustrations, no gradients, no dotted grids, no blur blobs, no glassmorphism, no huge title filling the screen, no bento grid, no emoji, no fake official seals, no DICT endorsement, no medical claims, no real patient data, no watermark.
